risk_reasons: Real-time chroma-key / background removal on high-res video frames can trigger high frame buffer allocation overhead and memory leaks if unmanaged.
WebAudio API autoplay policy will block audio passthrough without explicit user gesture tracking and resume() orchestration.
Background removal false positives on low-contrast subjects (dark monochrome logos on dark backgrounds) require corner sampling heuristics and tolerance thresholds.

agent_lanes.designer: Design ControlPanel signal controls (exposure, saturation, sharpness, invert, edge detection, background removal section with tolerance/feather/targetColor controls), audio toggle and volume meter, fastfetch terminal widget layout with system stats and ASCII branding.
agent_lanes.fixer: Implement signal processing chain in canvas-renderer.ts / WebGL shaders, integrate WebAudio passthrough in VideoStreamingEngine with autoplay resume defense, wire background removal luminance/chroma heuristic with pre-allocated buffer clamping, update App.tsx and types.ts.

architecture.system_overview: Tauri v2 native cross-platform application delivering high-performance, dark minimalist ASCII rendering. Upgrades core pipeline with: (1) Extended Signal Adjustments (exposure, saturation, sharpness, invert, Sobel edge detection), (2) Real-Time Background Removal (corner-sampling color tolerance + luminance keying with zero CSP external ML dependencies), (3) Concurrent WebAudio Passthrough for video streaming with autoplay policy resilience, and (4) Widget-like Fastfetch system telemetry dashboard.

signal_adjustments_pipeline.model: AsciiRenderOptions (exposure, saturation, sharpness, invert, edgeDetection, edgeThreshold, bgRemoval)
processing_stages: Stage 1 - Color Matrix & Pre-correction: Apply exposure (-100..100) and gamma (0.1..3.0) directly to linear RGB values.
Stage 2 - Saturation & Tone Curve: Compute luminance (Y = 0.299R + 0.587G + 0.114B), interpolate R/G/B towards luminance by saturation factor, apply contrast curve.
Stage 3 - Sharpness / Edge Enhancement: Unsharp masking convolution kernel (3x3 Laplacian) to boost high-frequency contrast.
Stage 4 - Sobel Edge Detection: Optional Sobel gradient magnitude thresholding replacing grayscale values with edge outlines.
Stage 5 - Background Removal & Masking: Corner-sampled Euclidean color distance or luminance keying with feather radius; zero-out alpha/luminance for masked pixels.

background_removal_subsystem.detection_protocol: Corner-sampling heuristic (averaging 4 canvas corners [0,0], [W-1,0], [0,H-1], [W-1,H-1]) to infer dominant background color or user-specified target hex. Computes Euclidean distance in RGB/Lab space.
background_removal_subsystem.feathering: Box blur / clamping on the binary mask to prevent harsh jagged ASCII stepping along subject contours.
background_removal_subsystem.csp_compliance: 100% native CPU/Canvas2D/WebGL execution; zero external CDN dependencies, fully compliant with strict Tauri CSP.

audio_passthrough_pipeline.architecture: AudioContext instantiated on user interaction. MediaElementAudioSourceNode created from HTMLVideoElement (with video.muted=true for browser autoplay compliance). Routed through GainNode to AudioContext.destination.
audio_passthrough_pipeline.resilience: Monitors AudioContext.state ('suspended' -> 'running'). Explicit user gesture unlocks audio context with graceful fallback.

fastfetch_widget_subsystem.aesthetic: Terminal-style fastfetch system banner featuring ASCII logo, host OS/architecture, GPU model, active rendering tier, live render FPS, VRAM/memory estimate, and audio state.
fastfetch_widget_subsystem.layout: Collapsible side/bottom drawer or header card with monospace typography and 1px crisp borders (#222224).

motion_lifecycle.unmount_cleanup: AudioContext suspended/closed, video elements unhooked from AudioSourceNode, typed arrays de-referenced, DOM nodes unmounted cleanly
motion_lifecycle.orchestrated_moment: Single orchestrated load screen boot pulse at application startup; all subsequent tab transitions and widget toggles are static and instant.

breaking_scenarios.name: High-Res Video Frame Buffer Allocation Overload During Real-Time Chroma-Keying
breaking_scenarios.vector: User loads a 4K 60 FPS video with background removal and edge detection active; repeated per-frame buffer reallocations overwhelm garbage collector and GPU memory
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Out of memory crash, browser tab freeze, garbage collection stutters causing frame rate drop to < 10 FPS
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: The engine pre-allocates reusable Uint8ClampedArray and ImageData buffers based on target ASCII grid resolution (e.g. 120x60 or max clamped 240x120), downsampling the video frame prior to chroma-keying and edge filtering so that memory allocation is O(1) during live playback
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Clamp sampling canvas dimensions to target grid dimensions; reuse persistent buffers across frame loops

breaking_scenarios.name: AudioContext Blocked by Browser Autoplay Policy / User Gesture Requirement
breaking_scenarios.vector: User loads or seeks video; video playback begins automatically but browser/webview halts audio output with AudioContext in 'suspended' state
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Audio fails silently or throws DOMException; user hears nothing while video ASCII streams; unhandled promise rejection stalls engine
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: VideoStreamingEngine intercepts AudioContext.state. If suspended, it records isAutoplayBlocked=true, exposes a non-intrusive 'Unmute Audio' pill in the UI, and attaches a one-time global click/keydown handler that calls audioContext.resume() synchronously upon the first user interaction
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Detect suspended state; attach click handler to call audioContext.resume(); restore GainNode volume gracefully without crackle

breaking_scenarios.name: Background Detector False Positive on Low-Contrast Subjects
breaking_scenarios.vector: User loads a dark monochrome Arch Linux logo or dark figure against a dark slate background, or white subject against light background, with tolerance set too high
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Entire subject is eliminated as background, leaving an empty ASCII screen or fragmented holes in the subject body
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: The background removal algorithm implements corner sampling fallback (verifying variance among 4 corners before auto-keying), clamps default tolerance to conservative threshold (40/255), and provides user-accessible color tolerance slider, invert mask toggle, and target color picker to immediately fine-tune detection boundaries
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Sample 4 distinct corner clusters; if corner variance exceeds threshold, fall back to center-weighted contrast preservation or notify user to adjust tolerance slider

breaking_scenarios.name: Rapid Signal Parameter Thrashing During 60 FPS Video Playback
breaking_scenarios.vector: User rapidly drags exposure, saturation, sharpness, and background removal sliders simultaneously while 60 FPS video is rendering
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: UI thread lockup, state thrashing in React re-render loop, dropped frames on canvas paint
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: AsciiRenderOptions ref is updated synchronously for the render loop while React state updates are debounced/batched via requestAnimationFrame, ensuring the canvas loop reads latest atomic options without triggering hundreds of redundant component reconciliations
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Decouple render engine options pointer from React component re-renders; batch state updates using startTransition or rAF
